pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal and sub-rectangular patches of medium-brown pigmentation. Edges are distinct but exhibit a soft pixel gradient at the transition to the inter-patch space. Patches on the central torso are larger in spatial area than those transitioning towards the ventral line.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of wide, cream-colored interstitial pathways. The topology is characterized by frequent tri-radial junction nodes and high continuity without significant occlusion or thinning.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark avian passenger (Oxpecker) located on the right-hand lateral margin of the upper neck.
